The first moves from the left through the origin to the right. The second traces the right branch to the origin and back. The third approaches the excluded origin along the right branch.

check.en: The exponential never vanishes and even powers never become negative.

en: No slip makes travel distance equal the rotated arc length, so the center is \((r\theta,r)\).
The point is above-left of the center with displacement \((-r\sin\theta,-r\cos\theta)\). Cosine is negative here, giving positive vertical displacement.

check.ko: 사분면에 따른 부호를 포함하므로 첫 사분면 공식과 같은 식이 연속적으로 이어진다.

statement.en: A circle of radius \(r\) rolls with a point at distance \(d\) from its center. Set angle zero at its lowest position, derive the trochoid equations, and plot the two distance regimes.

hint.ko: 같은 매개변수 값을 두 좌표에 넣고 정의역과 진행 방향을 유지한다.
hint.en: Pair coordinates at the same parameter, retaining domain and orientation.

en: The center moves horizontally by radius times angle. The point’s relative displacement is the rotated downward radius vector.
When the point distance is smaller than radius, horizontal velocity stays positive; a larger distance gives temporary backward motion and loops.

check.ko: 거리가 반지름과 같으면 원주 위의 cycloid 첨점이 된다.
